hireFaqs.question: What is the best way to start?
hireFaqs.answer: Send the current workflow, blockers, target outcome, and timeline. I will turn that into a milestone suggestion or the next most useful starting scope.

hireFaqs.question: Can you work inside an existing product and codebase?
hireFaqs.answer: Yes. Most of the work shown here was delivered inside existing systems with constraints, active stakeholders, and handoff requirements.

hireFaqs.question: Do you only work on Android?
hireFaqs.answer: No. Android + AI is a strong secondary specialization. The main focus is AI workflows, internal tools, automation systems, and product delivery across web and backend stacks.

hireFaqs.question: How do you handle remote collaboration?
hireFaqs.answer: Async-first updates, scoped milestones, clear blockers, and delivery notes so teams can keep moving without constant meetings.
